description: Convert one CSS absolute length. An inch is 96px and 2.54 cm, so a centimetre is 4800/127 px, a millimetre is 480/127 px, and Q (a quarter-millimetre) is 120/127 px. A point is 4/3 px and a pica is 16px. Units: px, in, cm, mm, Q, pt, pc. em, rem, percent and viewport units are rejected. Exact rationals, 12 decimal places. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/css-length
